name: Logto
description: Logto is an open-source identity and access management (IAM) platform for building sign-in, authentication, and authorization. It provides OIDC-based auth, a prebuilt sign-in experience, user and role management, and an Admin Console, backed by PostgreSQL.

notes.text: Open the Admin Console at https://<IP>:3002 and accept the self-signed certificate; also open https://<IP>:3001 once and accept it there (the sign-in flow redirects between both ports). Then complete the Welcome flow to create your first admin account. HTTPS is required: the console uses Web Crypto (crypto.subtle), which browsers only expose in secure (HTTPS) contexts.

TLS is terminated by nginx with a self-signed certificate (SAN includes the container IP). Core/OIDC API is on https://<IP>:3001, Admin Console on https://<IP>:3002. For a browser-trusted cert, replace /etc/ssl/logto/logto.{crt,key} or front Logto with your own reverse proxy and a real domain.
